function.name: A_new_function
function.description: Extract information from the following clinical note

age_min.description: What is the minimum age of eligibility (in years)?. Examples: 2

age_max.description: What is the maximum age of eligibility (in years)?. Examples: 25

weight_min.description: What is the minimum weight a patient may have and still be eligibile (in kilograms)?

weight_max.description: What is the maximum weight a patient may have and still be eligibile (in kilograms)?

sex.description: Which sexes are eligible in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: "Male", "Female"

diagnosis.description: Which diagnoses are eligible in this clinical trial?. Examples: Diagnoses include "Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL)", "Acute myeloid leukemia (AML)", "Down syndrome acute myeloid leukemia (DS AML)", "B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (B-ALL)", "Juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML)", "Mixed-phenotype acute leukemia (MPAL)", "Myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS)", "Myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) who have progressed to AML", "Treatment-related acute myeloid leukemia (tAML)", "T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL)", "Acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL)", "KMT2A acute lymphoblastic leukemia", "Early T-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ETP-ALL)", "Ambiguous lineage acute leukemia (ALAL)"
enum: "Myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) who have progressed to AML"

ever_refractory.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention refractory disease?. Examples: refractory disease are diseases such as "Refractory leukemia"

count_refractory.description: If the criteria mention refractory disease, how many occurrences of refractory disease are required?

current_refractory_num_cycles.description: What is the minimum number of cycles of therapy required for refractory disease mentioned in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: the answer is 1 if "refractory to at least one course of salvage therapy", the answer is 2 if "persistent after at least two courses of induction "chemotherapy", the answer is 2 if "refractory disease after >= 2 cycles of chemotherapy"

ever_relapse.description: Is confirmed or suspected relapse disease mentioned in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: relapse diesease such as "relapsed leukemia"

count_relapse.description: What is the minimum number of relapses required for eilgibility? If not found, return null.. Examples: the answer is 2 if "Second or greater relapse", the answer is 1 if "first relapses"

bm_recent_blast_pct_meas.description: What is the minimum bone marrow blast percentage mentioned in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: the answer is 5 if ">= 5% blasts in the bone marrow", the answer is 5 if "> 5% blasts in the BM" is mentioned

bm_recent_blast_method.description: What are the required methods for bone marrow blast percentage assessment mentioned in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: "Morphology", "Flow cytometry"

periph_blood_blast_abs_meas.description: What is the peripheral blood absolute blast count measurement (in cells/microliter) mentioned in the eligibility criteria?

periph_blood_blast_pct_meas.description: What is the minimum defined peripheral blood blast percentage mentioned in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: the answer is 5 if ">= 5% blasts in the peripheral blood" is mentioned, the answer is 5 if ">=5% blasts in the blood" is mentioned

corneal_epitheliopathy.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention diagnosis of corneal epitheliopathy or any eye disorder that may predispose the patient to corneal epitheliopathy?

cns_status.description: What CNS status is mentioned in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: "CNS 1", "CNS 2", "CNS 3"

lanksy_min.description: What is the minimum Lansky score a patient must have to be eligible?. Examples: the answer is 70 if "Lansky score>=70" is mentioned

karnofksy_min.description: What is the minimum Karnofsky score a patient must have to be eligible?. Examples: the answer is 50 if "Karnofsky score >= 50" is mentioned

diag_down_syndrome.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of Down syndrome?

diag_iso_emd.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of isolated extramedullary disease (i.e. the absence of bone marrow involvement)?

diag_iso_testes.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of isolated testicular relapse?

diag_ataxia_telang.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of ataxia-telangiectasia?

diag_bloom.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of Bloom syndrome?

diag_fanconi.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of Fanconi anemia?

diag_kostmann.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of Kostmann syndrome?

diag_shwachman.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of Shwachman syndrome?

diag_cong_bmf.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of any known congenital bone marrow failure syndrome (e.g. Fanconi anemia, Kostmann syndrome, Shwachman syndrome)?

diag_malabsoption.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of malabsorption syndrome?

diag_chf.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of congestive heart failure (CHF)?

diag_hiv.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection?

diag_uncontr_cns.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of clinically significant uncontrolled central nervous system (CNS) pathology (e.g. epilepsy, childhood seizure, paresis, aphasia, stroke, severe brain injuries, organic brain syndrome, or psychosis)?

diag_hep_b_c.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of hepatitis B or C infection?

diag_liver_cirr_serious.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of liver cirrhosis or other serious liver disease?

active_infection.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a documented active, uncontrolled infection?

refractory_transfusion.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention being refractory to red blood cells or platelet transfusions?

cerebellar_toxicity.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention an history of cerebellar toxicity or cerebellar neurological findings on exam?

exp_cytotoxic_chemo_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to cytotoxic chemotherapy (not including intrathecal cytotoxic chemotherapy, hydroxyurea, or corticosteroids)?

exp_corticosteroids_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to corticosteroids (if used to modify immune adverse events related to prior therapy)?

exp_anticancer_nonmyelosupp_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to non-myelosuppressive anti-cancer agents?

exp_anticancer_myelosupp_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to myelosuppressive anti-cancer agents?

exp_antibody_drug_conj_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to antibody-drug conjugate?

exp_interleukins_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Interleukins, Interferons and Cytokines (not including Hematopoietic Growth Factors)?

exp_long_acting_gf_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Long-acting growth factor (eg, pegfilgrastim)?

exp_short_acting_gf_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Short-acting growth factor?

exp_rt_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Radiotherapy (RT)?

exp_craniospatial_rt_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Craniospinal radiotherapy (RT)?

exp_tbi_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Total Body Irradiation (TBI)?

exp_radiopharma_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Radiopharmaceutical therapy (e.g., radiolabeled antibody, 131I-MIBG)?

exp_hct.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT)?

type_transplant.description: What type(s) of transplant are mentioned in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: "Allogeneic", "Autologous", "Both"

exp_dli_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to DLI (donor lymphocyte infusion) or any type of cellular therapy (eg, modified T cells, NK cells, dendritic cells, etc.)?

exp_cyp2d6_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Strong inhibitors of CYP2D6?

exp_cyp3a4_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Strong inhibitors of CYP3A4?

exp_cyp3a_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Strong inhibitors of CYP3A?

exp_calcineurin_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to calcineurin inhibitors?

exp_monocl_antib_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to monoclonal antibodies?

exp_immunotherapy_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to immunotherapy?

exp_gpc3_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to GPC3-directed immunotherapy?

exp_demeth_hdac_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to Demethylating and/or HDAC Inhibitor Therapy?

exp_cd123_cart.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to CD123 directed antibody or CD123 directed chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cells?

exp_anthracycline_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to anthracycline or equivalent?

cumul_anthracycline.description: How much cumulative anthracycline or equivalent (in mg/m^2) is mentioned in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: the answer is 450 mg/m^2, if "total cumulative doses of non-liposomal daunorubicin, or other anthracycline equivalent, greater than 450 mg/m^2"

gvhd.description: Is presence of graft versus host disease, or GVHD, excluded from this study?. Examples: "active uncontrolled graft versus host disease (GvHD)"

vpa_meds.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to receiving valproic acid (VPA) therapy?

prior_solid_organ_transpl.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a prior solid organ transplantation?

exp_uproleselan.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention prior exposure to uproleselan?

exp_flotetuzumab.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention prior exposure to flotetuzumab?

exp_venetoclax.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention venetoclax?

exp_venetoclax_sensitive.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention previous toxicity or hypersensitivity directly attributed to venetoclax?

donor_available.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a suitable stem cell donor available?

dyspnea_present.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention evidence of dyspnea?

hypoxia_present.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention evidence of hypoxia?

expression_msln.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention evidence of MSLN expression?

expression_cd123.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention evidence of CD123 expression?

expression_eselectin.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention evidence of E-selectin expression?

expression_kmt2ar.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention evidence of KMT2A rearrangement (KMT2Ar)?

expression_t1517.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention evidence of t(15;17) translocation?

expression_som_JAK2_V617F.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention evidence of somatic JAK2 V617F mutation?

expression_flt3_itd.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention evidence of FLT3 / internal tandem duplication (ITD) mutation?

diag_cong_blood_disorder.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any congenital bleeding disorders, including but not limited to hemophilia?

diag_intercurrent_illness.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of any significant intercurrent disease?

diag_mets_cns.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention Metastatic CNS involvement?

diag_hemolytic_anemia.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of hemolytic anemia?

diag_evans_syndrome.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of Evans syndrome?

diag_uncontrolled_cardiac_rhythm.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention uncontrolled cardiac rhythm disturbance?

diag_severe_psychiatric_disorder.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of acute or chronic severe psychiatric disorders?

diag_other_malignancies.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of other malignancies?

diag_pneumonitis.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of pneumonitis?

diag_mibg_avidity.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention indications of tumor(s) / lesion(s) with known MIBG avidity?

diag_fdg_avidity.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention tumor(s) / lesion(s) with known FDG avidity?

diag_signif_pleural_effusion.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention clinically significant, symptomatic, pleural effusions?

diag_signif_pericardial_effusion.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention physiologically significant pericardial effusion?

diag_measureable_disease.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention the patient having measurable disease?

diag_measureable_tumor.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention the patient having one or more tumor / lesion sites with measurable dimensions?

diag_primary_immunodeficiency.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention a diagnosis of primary immunodeficiency?

exp_cellular_therapy.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to  live cellular therapy (natural killer [NK] cell, chimeric antigen receptor T-cell [CAR-T cell])?

exp_ch14_18_sensitive.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention previous toxicity or hypersensitivity directly attributed to ch14.18 (CHO or SP2/0)?

exp_anti_gd2_sensitive.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention previous toxicity or hypersensitivity directly attributed to anti-GD2 monoclonal antibody (dinutuximab)?

exp_hu5f9g4_sensitive.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention previous toxicity or hypersensitivity directly attributed to Hu5F9-G4 (magrolimab) monoclonal antibody?

exp_gm_csf_sensitive.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention previous toxicity or hypersensitivity directly attributed to GM-CSF or dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO)?

exp_pd1_pdl_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to  any PD-1, PD-L1, or PD-L2 targeting antibodies (e.g. Nivolumab)?

exp_anti_ctla4_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to  any anti-CTLA4 agent?

exp_lorlatinib_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to  lorlatinib?

exp_cd47_sirpalpha_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to  any CD47–SIRPα-targeted therapeutics?

exp_ivig_ever.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention any prior exposure to  Intravenous Immunoglobulin (IVIg) therapy?

cumul_131l_mibg.description: How much cumulative 131I-MIBG dosing (in mCi/kg) is mentioned in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: the answer is > 54 mCi/kg, if "treated with iodine-131 (131I)-MIBG who have already received a cumulative I-131 dose > 54 mCi/kg or who would exceed 54 mCi/kg by participating"

expression_alk.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention evidence of ALK mutation?

expression_alk_type.description: What types of ALK mutations are mentioned in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: "Rearrangement (ALK-R)", "Amplification (ALK-A)", "Point mutation"

bclc_stage.description: What BCLC stage is mentioned in the eligibility criteria?. Examples: "Stage 0", "Stage A", "Stage B", "Stage C", "Stage D"

ctp_score.description: What Child-Pugh-Turcotte score is mentioned in the eligibility criteria?

expression_gpc3.description: Does the eligibility criteria mention evidence of GPC3 expression?
